news.title: Argentina Extend Head Coach Lionel Scaloni’s Contract Through 2030 World Cup
news.lede: Argentina coach Lionel Scaloni renewed his contract with the national team on Thursday through 2030, putting him on track to become the first manager to lead La Albiceleste at three World Cups. The 48-year-old Scaloni coached Argentina to the World Cup title in 2022 and a runner-up finish this year after losing the final to Spain. His previous contract was set to expire in December. "After giving it some thought and discussing it with my coaching staff and those close to me, we decided that continuing is the best path forward," Scaloni said at a news conference on Thursday.

news.title: Official! Lionel Scaloni signs new Argentina contract through 2030 to become first coach to lead Albiceleste at three World Cups
news.lede: Lionel Scaloni has officially committed his future to Argentina, signing a landmark contract extension that will see him lead the national team through the 2030 World Cup. The new agreement cements his status as a legendary figure in South American football following a period of unprecedented success on the global stage. Historic extension for the World Cup winner The Argentine Football Association (AFA) has confirmed that Scaloni will remain at the helm of the national team for four more years. Since taking the reins in 2018, the 48-year-old has transformed Argentina into a dominant force.

news.title: Manchester Utd tap Pochettino for coach vacancy after sacking manager
news.lede: United States head coach Mauricio Pochettino is set to be appointed as the new manager of Manchester United after the struggling English giants sacked Michael Carrick on Thursday. Pochettino is widely expected to leave his role with the USA following their two-legged CONCACAF Nations League quarter-final on Saturday and Tuesday in a move that will see United trigger a release clause worth some US$10 million to secure the Argentine coach's services. The former Tottenham Hotspur coach, who signed a contract extension to remain with the United States through to the 2030 World Cup just three months ago, is due to hold a pre-match press conference on Friday. Former United captain Carrick led the team to an impressive third-place finish in the Premier League last season, but they have taken just eight points from 10 games in the current campaign and are in the relegation zone.

news.title: FIFA's 2031 Women's World Cup could make history with four host nations and 48 teams
news.lede: The Briefing: FIFA published its bid evaluation report on November 11, finding the joint U.S.-Mexico-Costa Rica-Jamaica submission for the 2031 Women's World Cup meets minimum hosting requirements with a score of 4.4 out of 5 — the only bid received for that edition. An Extraordinary FIFA Congress will convene by videoconference on November 23, 2026, so all 211 member associations can vote to formally award hosting rights for the 2031 and 2035 Women's World Cups. If approved, the 2031 tournament will be the first Women's World Cup hosted across four nations simultaneously, featuring 48 teams and 104 matches — 40 more than the 2023 edition in Australia and New Zealand. Eleven days from now, 211 FIFA member associations will log on for a virtual vote that is poised to deliver the most consequential decision in the history of women's football.

news.title: Black Challenge arrive in Mexico ahead of 2026 Amputee Football World Cup
news.lede: Ghana’s national amputee football team, the Black Challenge, have arrived in Guadalajara, Mexico, ahead of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup. The team arrived at their hotel at 5:00 a.m. on Thursday after more than 20 hours of travel by road and air. The Black Challenge will now settle in and prepare for the tournament, which brings together 24 national teams from across the world. The team are scheduled to hold their first training session on Friday as they step up preparations for the competition.
